notes.title: v1.1.17 – UI Updates, New Spell, and Balance Tweaks
notes.notes: [p]This update focuses on polishing gameplay with some bug fixes, UI improvements, and a few balance tweaks. There’s also a new Light-element spell to help deal with swarms of enemies.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New & Updated Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cleansing Wave (Light)[/b] – New low-cost AoE spell for quickly clearing out groups of weaker enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Holy Hand Grenade[/b] – Increased damage and area-of-effect radius.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Core Health Boost[/b] – All Cores now start with [b]512 HP[/b] (up from 256).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sunbeam Tower[/b] – Slightly reduced attack range from 15 to 14.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated Spell Archive (new spell reward) UI for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Emergency repair charges are now shown directly in the HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved placement confirmation pointer for spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Better visual feedback for click-to-move commands.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted font sizes and padding in tutorial panels for easier reading.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing too many enemies to spawn in later waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls now correctly clear obstructions when placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HP bar not initializing properly in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Virtual cursor will no longer update while hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed ghost placement movement for towers, spells, and Cores.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized enemy attack code for better performance in large battles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback! Let me know what you think of the changes, and if you spot any other bugs or have ideas for balance and tuning.[/p]

notes.title: Update v1.1.11 – Visual Overhaul, Balance Tweaks, and QoL Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]This one’s all about cleanup. updated a bunch of visuals, smoothed out some systems, and made the game a bit more readable and forgiving in the right places. It’s not a huge content drop, but it should make every run feel better.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:

[b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Final biome difficulty reduced to smooth out the endgame curve.[/p][/*][*][p]Max spawners per mission reduced to 4 for better pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Wave spawning improved for more consistent encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Health Regen buffed, with additional upgrade levels available.[/p][/*][*][p]Emergency Repair cost adjusted for easier purchase in the early game.[/p][/*][*][p]Wall mana costs rebalanced to support more terrain interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]First map nodes will no longer spawn as Elite encounters.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visuals & UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Core, Tower, and Spell icons updated with new visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]All Upgrade and Currency icons updated with new visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Forge UI overhauled for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Map Info Panel improved to highlight rewards and encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed Rewards:[/p][list][*][p]Core Charger ➜ Repair Kit[/p][/*][*][p]Core Shield ➜ Vitality[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Core placement and cleanse effects enhanced with improved visuals and feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bar now shows yellow for damage taken and green for healing received.[/p][/*][*][p]Interactable rewards now show a clear "claimed" effect when activated.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rare voxel rendering race conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain rendering bugs causing visual inconsistencies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player movement during the Map Room tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all the feedback lately. More updates are coming, but in the meantime, I hope this one smooths out your next few runs.[/p]

notes.title: v1.1 Release - The World Evolves and the Blight Spreads
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Version [b]v1.1[/b] introduces some of the biggest changes to [i]Stop the Blight[/i] so far, including a redesigned map progression system, a major terrain rendering update, GPU-based Blight rendering, and a new type of non-combat encounter that adds depth to both gameplay and story.[/p][p][/p][h3]Hidden Outpost[/h3][p]Hidden Outposts are quiet, forgotten shelters left behind during the rise of the Blight. Found in any biome, they offer a [b]random reward[/b] with no combat required. These rest sites provide helpful resources like coins, rune upgrades, or new spells for the run.[/p][p]In future updates, they’ll also begin to [b]reveal lore[/b] about the world’s history and the true origins of the Blight. Expect them to play a larger role as the story unfolds.[/p][p][/p][h3]Node-Based Biome Maps[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690584/3b0f956bb6372ceb437c3fc1c76b42790b514cd5.png"][/img][/p][p]Previously, biome progression was pretty straightforward. You chose a biome, selected missions from a list each turn, and after a few encounters, the boss became available. It worked, but it didn’t offer much strategy and could feel repetitive.[/p][p]The old system has been replaced with a [b]node-based progression map[/b]. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]You now move from [b]left to right[/b] across a connected network of nodes.[/p][/*][*][p]Each step gives you [b]1 to 3 encounter options[/b], allowing for meaningful choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Every node displays its [b]reward[/b] up front, helping you plan your route.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Branching paths[/b] let you choose between shorter or longer routes.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]reroll available encounters[/b] after unlocking a specific upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Each biome now has its own [b]unique map[/b], offering six distinct layouts.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Smooth Voxel Terrain[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690584/dea3184c4739b120b0b3f6ca03bae5cbb0693202.png"][/img][/p][p]Another big change in this update is the transition from [b]cubic voxel terrain[/b] to a [b]smooth rendering system[/b] using naive surface nets. This new approach brings several key improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Better performance[/b]: Surface nets significantly reduce vertex and triangle counts. With Burst compilation and multithreading, each chunk now renders in about [b]3 to 6 milliseconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]More Natural Terrain[/b]: Slopes, ridges, and curves now appear fluid rather than blocky, giving the world a more organic look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Tower Targeting[/b]: With smoother terrain, towers have a clearer line of sight and are more accurate when targeting enemies. Previously, blocky terrain could cause towers to hit block corners instead of their intended targets.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]GPU-Based Blight Rendering[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690584/754877b6e9bb8dcd88a9620d5ea97fc8cc821e17.png"][/img][/p][p]The terrain upgrade also led to a full rewrite of how the Blight system is rendered.[/p][p]Previously, the Blight had to overwrite voxel materials directly. For example, changing a dirt block into a blighted one. Every change required re-rendering the affected terrain chunk, which slowed things down and locked the visuals to a rigid grid.[/p][p]Now, all Blight rendering is handled entirely on the [b]GPU[/b] using a [b]custom shader[/b]. Here’s what that means:[/p][list][*][p][b]Instant updates[/b]: When corruption changes, the Blight appears immediately with no terrain rebuild.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Huge performance boost[/b]: The CPU no longer has to touch terrain data or trigger re-renders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother visuals[/b]: The Blight spreads fluidly across the terrain, no longer stuck to the voxel grid.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who shared feedback and ideas. These changes are the direct result of those conversations. I’m excited to keep pushing the game forward and expanding on these systems in future updates.[/p]

notes.title: Tutorial Update + Small Balance Tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Today’s update brings a more intuitive and helpful tutorial system to Stop the Blight, along with a few small balance adjustments.

The new tutorial is designed to make things easier to learn without slowing you down. It now includes short video previews, shows input bindings for both mouse+keyboard and gamepad users, and gives clearer explanations for walls. Since building efficient paths is a key part of the game’s strategy.

Tutorial Improvements:
[list]
[*] Reworked tutorial flow to feel more intuitive
[*] Short video clips added to show what each mechanic looks like
[*] Displays correct input bindings for both mouse/keyboard and gamepad
[*] Improved clarity around how walls work and why they matter
[*] The old tutorial used the same dialog system as story/lore text, which caused some players to skip it thinking it wasn’t important. The new system is separate from dialog and visually distinct, so it’s easier to recognize and follow
[/list]

Balance Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the movement speed for all enemies
[*] Reduced damage from terraforming spells from 18 -> 8 (raising, lowering, and leveling terrain spells are intended to be support instead of damage spells)
[/list]

This is part of a larger effort to improve onboarding and help new players understand the game’s core systems right away. As always, thanks for playing and sharing your feedback. If you have ideas, questions, or just want to hang out, come join us on Discord.

notes.title: The Demo is Back – With a Balance Pass!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
The demo for [i]Stop the Blight[/i] is now available again! It’s been brought up to date with the current version of the game, so if you’ve been waiting to check it out (or want to see how much has changed since the original demo), now’s a great time.

This update also includes a balance pass aimed at increasing the challenge during a run. The Blight spreads faster, towers are under more pressure, and a few spells have been re-tuned.

[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Cores now break into tiny pieces when destroyed
[*] Holy Hand Grenade now clears blight on explosion
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes (Increased Run Difficulty)[/b]
[list]
[*] Portals are now invulnerable
[*] Slightly reduced mana cost for all wall types
[*] Blight damage to towers increased: 10 → 18 per tick
[*] Blight growth increased: 100 → 192 per tick (every 3 seconds)
[*] Rejuvenate spell rate of fire reduced: 1s → 2s
[*] Daybreak Cannon direct damage reduced from 24 -> 22
[*] Sunbeam Spire:
[list]
[*] Starting DPS reduced: 10 → 8
[*] Damage ramping reduced: +1/s → +0.5/s
[*] Max damage reduced: 20 → 16
[*] (Now deals 8 DPS at start, 16 DPS after 16s on target)
[/list]
[*] Blight Purifier:
[list]
[*] Mana cost reduced: 32 → 28
[*] Blight clearing radius increased
[*] Healing amounts reduced: 16 → 12, 20 → 15, 24 → 18
[/list]
[/list]

This is part of an ongoing effort to fine-tune balance and push the strategic side of the game even further. Thanks to everyone who’s been offering feedback and reporting bugs, it’s been incredibly helpful.

As always, feel free to jump into the Discord to share your thoughts or just hang out with the community.

notes.title: Stop the Blight is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
I'm incredibly excited (and a little nervous!) to announce that [i]Stop the Blight[/i] is officially released!

This has been my passion project for a long time. While I built most of it solo, I had help from some amazing freelancers who contributed 3D models, artwork, and music. Their talent really helped bring the world to life.

The game is a [b]tactical tower defense roguelite[/b] built around spellcasting, terrain manipulation, and elemental strategy—and now it’s in your hands.

That said, [b]this is just the beginning[/b]. There's still more I want to add and improve, and your feedback will help shape where things go next. Here's what's planned for post-launch:

[list]
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Improved sound effects and possibly more music
[*] Storyline completion with character dialog and lore snippets
[*] More permanent upgrades, more runes, and more strategic depth
[/list]

If you've been following the project—[b]thank you[/b]. And if you're just discovering it now, [b]welcome![/b] I hope you enjoy playing as much as I’ve enjoyed building it.

Please feel free to join the community, share your thoughts, and help me make this game even better. Your support makes everything possible.

Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/gQbn2t5Yfy
